text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_score
Description
This iRules command returns the alert severity
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_score
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert score: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_score]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
